products.short_description: Execute M365→Google with BitTitan MigrationWiz — projects + endpoints, mail/document/Teams migrations, pre-stage and delta passes with throttling, and validation — so migrations run predictably at scale. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Execute M365→Google migrations with BitTitan MigrationWiz

Many enterprises run their M365→Google move on BitTitan MigrationWiz — a SaaS migration platform for mail, documents, and collaboration. This solution is the MigrationWiz execution playbook: set up the project and endpoints (M365 + Google), deploy the Device Management Agent where needed, configure mail/document/Teams-to-Chat projects, run pre-stage and delta passes with throttling, and validate — so migrations run predictably at enterprise scale.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run Python (Admin SDK / APIs).

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the MigrationWiz model (projects, endpoints, agents, pre-stage/delta passes), where it fits vs native tools, and the wave approach.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (MigrationWiz account + licensing, M365 + Google admin access/app registrations, endpoints, pilot scope).
  • Implementation Guide — create project + endpoints, configure mail/document/Teams projects, run pre-stage + delta passes with throttling, validate, then scale waves — pilot-first; MigrationWiz console internals + licensing deferred to BitTitan docs, procedure and sequencing given.
  • 5 Python tools — assessment/discovery, a configuration or orchestration helper, a validation/report generator, a policy/health check, and a scope/config helper — authentic Google Workspace Admin SDK / API automation (read-only or dry-run by default; no credentials or keys in code).
  • Validation gates (pilot passes complete, delta clean, errors triaged) plus Best Practices for pre-stage/delta cutover sequencing.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

M365→Google migrations executed predictably on MigrationWiz — projects and endpoints set, pre-stage and delta passes run and validated — enterprise scale without surprises.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • Automation Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • btw-config-helper.py — endpoint-config + throttling-health helper for a MigrationWiz move (read-only)
    • btw-postmigration-validation.py — per-user post-migration validation report (mail/docs/chat)
    • btw-project-mapping-builder.py — build/validate the source->target line-item CSV MigrationWiz consumes
    • btw-readiness-assessment.py — read-only M365 source + Google target readiness baseline for a MigrationWiz move
    • btw-wave-planner.py — pre-stage/delta wave planner + throttling guidance for a MigrationWiz move

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all Python scripts and tools in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
